title: AI-Mediated Communication Can Steer Collective Opinion

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the directional shift in stance (scored from 0 'against' to 1 'in favor') between human-written texts and their LLM-edited counterparts across 13 contested socio-political topics using an ensemble of text embedding-based stance classifiers.

Using an LLM-as-a-judge to classify the stance of Grok-generated contextual claims on X (Twitter) posts about abortion as pro-choice, neutral, or pro-life, to calculate support and opposition asymmetries based on platform design prompts.
